bullets.text: A youth undergoing treatment at a de-addiction center in Mangadu was allegedly killed by staff members, creating panic and requiring close monitoring.
Police formed two special teams to hunt for a government bus conductor who allegedly lured and kidnapped a 14-year-old girl in Gummidipoondi.
The indigenously built warship INS Samarthak was inducted into the Indian Navy at Kattupalli in Thiruvallur district in the presence of Deputy Chairperson C.P. Radhakrishnan.
A Delhi youth was arrested in Avadi after swindling 1.90 crore rupees from a private firm general manager using a fake WhatsApp message.
Police arrested two individuals who smuggled ganja on a bus near Gummidipoondi, highlighting local narcotics enforcement efforts to watch closely.
CapitaLand inaugurated a new data centre in Ambattur, Chennai, in the presence of Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay, boosting local digital infrastructure.
Canadian Trade Minister Maninder Sidhu stated that Canadian companies are keen to deepen partnerships with Karnataka in AI, quantum computing, aerospace, and defence.
Applications for the IndiaAI Fellowship 2026-27 are currently open, offering undergraduate and graduate students up to 2 lakh rupees to study AI.
Chief Minister Stalin criticized actor-politician Vijay regarding drug mafias within his party, drawing statewide attention to political safety concerns.
